purpose: Discover and locally classify a diverse candidate set of psychology intervention, mechanism, measurement and human-AI activity-system papers relevant to HRP Transfer Lab and CSI.

query_families.label: Cognitive training and transfer
query_families.query: ("cognitive training" OR "working memory training" OR "executive function training") AND (intervention OR trial OR randomized OR randomised) AND (transfer OR cognition OR performance)

query_families.label: Attention and cognitive-control interventions
query_families.query: ("attention training" OR "cognitive control training" OR "executive control training") AND (intervention OR trial OR randomized OR randomised)

query_families.label: Reasoning and problem-solving interventions
query_families.query: ("reasoning training" OR "problem solving training" OR "critical thinking intervention") AND (trial OR intervention OR training)

query_families.label: Metacognition and learning-strategy interventions
query_families.query: (metacognitive OR metacognition OR "learning strategy") AND (intervention OR training OR randomized OR randomised) AND (learning OR memory OR education)

query_families.label: Self-regulation and implementation interventions
query_families.query: ("self-regulation" OR "implementation intention" OR "goal management training") AND (intervention OR trial OR randomized OR randomised)

query_families.label: Stress, emotion regulation and cognitive performance
query_families.query: ("stress regulation" OR "emotion regulation training" OR "resilience training") AND (cognitive OR attention OR memory OR decision) AND (intervention OR trial)

query_families.label: Digital psychological and behavioural interventions
query_families.query: ("digital intervention" OR "digital psychological intervention" OR "computerized intervention" OR "computerised intervention") AND (cognitive OR behaviour OR behavioral OR self-regulation) AND (trial OR evaluation)

query_families.label: Human-AI cognition and learning interventions
query_families.query: ("generative AI" OR "artificial intelligence" OR chatbot) AND (learning OR cognition OR reasoning OR decision OR "cognitive offloading") AND (intervention OR experiment OR trial OR training)

query_families.label: Workplace cognitive and workflow interventions
query_families.query: (workplace OR employee OR "knowledge work") AND (attention OR interruption OR cognition OR decision OR workload) AND (intervention OR experiment OR redesign)

query_families.label: Behaviour-change and functional interventions
query_families.query: ("behavior change intervention" OR "behaviour change intervention") AND (self-regulation OR cognition OR adherence OR functioning) AND (trial OR randomized OR randomised)

governance.notes: Outputs are discovery and abstract-screening candidates only. Abstract classification cannot establish efficacy, quality, RoB, certainty, transfer or recommendation authority.
